root_cause.text: In `verify_header()`, the assignment `*ns = NULL` at the start of the function overwrites the pointer to the previously allocated namespace string, causing a memory leak when the function is called multiple times during the unpacking of multiple profiles (the caller `aa_unpack` initializes `*ns` to NULL once before the loop).
root_cause.evidence: The patch removes the line `*ns = NULL;` from `verify_header()`, and the commit message states: "The function sets `*ns = NULL` on every call, leaking the namespace string allocated in previous iterations when multiple profiles are unpacked. This also breaks namespace consistency checking since *ns is always NULL when the comparison is made."
